Social networks Mission Le Dépôt center Community Food Depot, formerly NDG Food Depot, is an
organization non-profit community organization that works in collaboration with other community
partners community to tackle food security issues and reduce the difficulties of poverty. Description
Our objectives are: To increase access to healthy foods for low-income community members, in a
dignified and respectful manner. From reduce the social isolation of participants and strengthen

their connection with various sources of support. To develop healthy habits, knowledge and eating
skills. To promote personal development and commitment community of participants. To improve
understanding of poverty, of social justice and gaps in the food system, and to develop an inclusive
framework for take effective action against these problems.

Organization 2: New Hope Senior Center | New Hope Senior Citizens’ Center - NH URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-organisms/centrepour Personnesageesspéropenouveau/
Website: https://newhopendg.com/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details
6225, av. Godfrey, Montreal QC H4B 1K3 514-484-0425 514-484-3469 Opening hours SCHEDULE
Monday to Friday 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Social networks Mission Espoir Nouveau is a non-profit

community center that serves seniors in the NDG neighborhood of Montreal and beyond. Since
1979, we have offered a welcoming space for adults aged 50 and over, with a day program,
community lunches, meals on wheels, free activities and our gardening project intergenerational.
Thanks to these initiatives and other local services, Espoir Nouveau fights against food insecurity
and social isolation while promoting dignity, well-being and caring and inclusive community for

seniors Description Meals community, Monday and Wednesday at 12 p.m. Encourages
interpersonal contact through leisure activities: physical conditioning, friendly visits program

Organization 3: Côte-des-Neiges CDC Community Development Corporation URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/corporationdeveloppementcommunautair
edecotedesneigescdc/ Website: http://www.conseilcdn.qc.ca/ Description: ABOUT THE
ORGANIZATION Contact details 6767 ch. from Côte-des-Neiges, Montreal QC H3S 2T6
514-739-7731, ext. 228 514-739-7757 Social networks Contacts (1) ALIMATOU TOURÉ General
Director 514-739-7731 ext: 203 Contact this contact Mission The Côte-des-Neiges Community

Development Corporation (CDC de CDN) has mission to bring together community organizations in
the Côte-des-Neiges district, in order to promote solidarity and consultation between them with a
view to improving the quality and living conditions of the population, to fight against poverty,
discrimination and all forms of exclusion. Description OUR OBJECTIVES: Internally Facilitate the
circulation of information, complementarity, mutual assistance and consultation between member

organizations; To the extent of its means, act as a resource for organizations that express the need,
at the level for example, structuring, democratic functioning, fundraising; In the neighborhood
Initiate or support initiatives in the community aimed at improving social and/or economic conditions
of neighborhood residents; Initiate or support initiatives aimed at bringing together different cultural

communities and contributing to the fight against any discrimination, exclusion, marginalization;
Outside Defend the interests of the community and act as spokesperson for its members before the
various authorities governmental, public or private; Maintain links with pursuing organizations
similar purposes, in order to fuel the work of the CDC and its members and to maximize the impact
of their interventions.

Organization 4: Coalition for Food Security of Notre-Dame-de-Grâce URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/coalition-pour-la-securite-alimentaire-de-no
tre-lady-of-grace/ Website: https://www.ndg.ca/fr/coalition-for-food-security Description: ABOUT
THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 5964 rue Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, office 204, Montréal QC
H4A 1N1 514 484-1471 514 484-1687 Opening hours SCHEDULE Monday to Friday 9:00 a.m. to

5:00 p.m. Mission Our mission at the Coalition for Food Security Notre-Dame-de-Grâce is to ensure
that all residents have access to healthy food and affordable. By collaborating with our partners, we
strengthen the community's capacity to combat food insecurity and promote food justice.
Description Coalition for NDG food security works to guarantee access to sufficient, healthy,
affordable and culturally appropriate for all residents of Notre-Dame-de-Grâce. The coalition

facilitates collaboration between organizations by providing security-related services food.
Resource Guide: The Coalition has a vision where all residents will have access to adequate food.
Its mission is to strengthen the capacity of community members to ensure the food security of NDG
residents by promoting joint initiatives and sharing information on regional actions on food security.
Partners: Arrondissement of CDN-NDG, Bread & Beyond, CLSC Benny Farm CIUSSS

West-Central Montreal, Cummings Center, Food Depot, À Deux Mains, House Mosaik Family,
mind.heart.mouth, Center Espoir Nouveau, Parents, Committed to the Child Childhood (PEP),
Westhaven Community Center, L’Envol des Femmes Events & Activities & Projects: The Coalition
organizes various events and consultations to meet demand growing supply of food in NDG. She
participates in initiatives such as the NDG Green Fair and the Development Plan for a Nourishing

Community. Members: CIUSSS-CO Cavendish, NDG Community Council, The Depot Community
Food Center, St. Monica’s Food Pantry, St. Thomas Church, Concordia Greenhouse – City Farm
School, NDG Senior Citizens’ Council, Transition NDG, ICNA Relief Montreal Resource Center and
Food Bank, CSDM, New Hope, Head & Hands Useful documents and links: The Coalition has
created a guide to security resources and initiatives food in NDG to facilitate collaboration and

exchanges between partners. This guide is regularly updated online. For more information and to
get involved by making a donation, by becoming a volunteer or member, you can contact the Food
Security Coalition from NDG.

Organization 5: The MultiCaf Community Cafeteria URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/cafeteriacommunautairemulticaf/ Website:
http://www.multicaf.org/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 3591 av.
Appleton, Montreal QC H3S 1K5 514-733-0554 514-733-2760 Opening hours SCHEDULE The
community cafeteria is open to all who are in need: breakfast is served Monday to Thursday
between 9:30 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. Dinner is served Monday to Friday between 11:45 a.m. and 1

p.m. Food baskets are distributed to residents of the Côte-des-Neiges/Snowdon neighborhood on
Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, between 9 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. The Community Cafeteria
center is open Monday to Friday from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. and Friday from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. Mission
(cid:127) Provide meals and emergency service food for low-income people in the
Côte-des-Neiges/Snowdon neighborhood. (cid:127) Promote development of skills of low-income

people and facilitate their integration into the environment. (cid:127) Defend the rights of
disadvantaged people and raise community awareness of issues linked to poverty. Description The
MultiCaf Community Cafeteria, founded in 1986, is a non-profit organization which aims to help
disadvantaged people in the neighborhood Côte-des-Neiges/Snowdon. Our community cafeteria is
open to everyone from Monday to Friday where 260 hot meals as well as breakfast are served

daily. Our service food assistance provides some 750 families with food baskets every month
balanced according to the recommendations of the Canadian Food Guide, throughout the the year.
The ideal of the founders of MultiCaf was not limited to food assistance. They were convinced that
the problems linked to poverty required the organization to go further. MultiCaf was to become a
meeting place where disadvantaged people could come together to to avoid isolation and demand

together a just and equitable society. To this end, MultiCaf offers a large program of complementary
activities such as food workshops and other relevant topics, recreational outings, a monthly
newspaper (written by our members), etc. Visit our website at www.multicaf.org

Organization 6: Lunch Box Workshops URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/ateliersboitealunch/ Website:
http://boitealunchndg.org/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 6244 Rue
Sherbrooke Ouest, Montreal QC H4B 1M2 514-967-6374 Social networks Contacts (1) MERISSA
NUDELMAN Coordinator 514 967 6374 Communicate with this contact Mission Les Ateliers Boîte à
Lunch, a project carried out by the Action 6-12 Committee since 2003, aims to educate people

about healthy eating and safety food for families in Notre-Dame-de-Grâce. As part of this project,
children from primary and secondary schools, as well as neighborhood families participate in
workshops educational and free cooking in connection with the community centers of
Notre-Dame-de-Grâce. Description Les Ateliers Boîte à Lunch is a program which aims to provide
education in healthy eating and food security for young people and families in

Notre-Dame-de-Grâce by carrying out free cooking and nutrition activities in community centers. As
part of this program, children from primary and secondary schools participate in educational
workshops where they prepare the contents of a healthy lunch box. Families also have the
opportunity to meet in neighborhood community centers to prepare and share meals. OUR
OBJECTIVES Improve the food security of young people and their families by: making it easier to

prepare and share free, nutritious meals; accompanying the participants in their learning of the
relationship between food, health, the economy, the environment sustainable, and cultural
traditions. Enhance self-esteem and autonomy by: developing knowledge, know-how and skills
related to food; promoting the development of social skills, strengthening the feeling of belonging
and developing a sense of cooperation; ensuring discovery and openness to different cultures

through learning the kitchen. encouraging the adoption of healthy lifestyle habits. Support parents
by: offering opportunities to break their isolation, strengthen their sense of belonging, develop better
support networks, and establish closer links with community services; creating collaboration spaces
that facilitate their integration into the community; reducing the obstacles to integration into the
labor market by providing places to practice the language French as well as offering work

experience opportunities; developing a better knowledge of attitudes promoting healthy eating and
health. OUR ACTIVITIES MAIN Extracurricular cooking workshops for children in 4th and 5th grade
primary. Extracurricular cooking workshops for high school students. Workshops cultural cooking
with the family. Summer picnics for families. A cooking program Meetings for parents. See more
information about our activities here!

Organization 7: Multicaf – Community Food Resource URL:
https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/multicaf-ressource-communautaire-en-alim entation/
Website: https://multicaf.org/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 3591 rue
Appleton, Montréal QC H3S 1K5 514 733-0554 514 733-2760 Opening hours SCHEDULE
reception: Monday to Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Mission The mission of MultiCaf is to provide

food aid, to create links social and seek resources to support vulnerable people in
Côte-des-Neiges. By promoting food autonomy and sustainable development, we Let's help fight
food insecurity and social isolation. Description MultiCaf is a non-profit organization located in
Côte-des-Neiges, Montreal, QC, Canada. Since its founding in 1989, MultiCaf committed to
providing food aid, creating social ties and seek resources for all vulnerable people in the area. In

response to the current food insecurity crisis, MultiCaf offers a variety of services to support the
community. The programs offered aim to meet the urgent needs of people low income, newcomers
to Quebec and any person going through a period financially difficult. Services offered by MultiCaf
include: 6 in-house food services and external 3 social services supported by dedicated workers
Agricultural projects developed since 2022 thanks to the INARI Network In addition to providing

economical meals and food emergency services, MultiCaf also offers a space dedicated to nutrition
and healthy eating, thus aiming to promote food autonomy and sustainable development within the
community. Thanks to its dedicated team, MultiCaf is able to offer advice, facilitate the search for
resources and direct members to other organizations able to meet their specific needs. The
organization regularly collaborates with universities and institutions to carry out research projects

on social issues such as homelessness, housing, nutrition and urban agriculture. With nearly 35
years of experience, MultiCaf is well anchored in the Côte-des-Neiges community. His commitment
to food security and social well-being makes it an essential player in the fight against insecurity food
and social isolation. If you are looking for food assistance, support social or simply a place to get
involved voluntarily, do not hesitate to contact MultiCaf. Together, we can help strengthen food
security and the social fabric of our community.
